description: Get the current production status in a namespace. Returns production name, state (Running/Stopped/Suspended/Troubled/NetworkStopped), and state code. Set detail=true to include item-level status (name, class, enabled, adapter).

detail.description: Include item-level detail when true (default: false)

namespace.description: Target namespace. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to query a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_production_status
title: Production Status
